description: Golden retrieval eval set for the Brightleaf Family Dental corpus. Ground truth is a verbatim span of source text, not a chunk id, so the labels stay valid when chunk size and overlap change.

questions.question: Are you open on Mondays at the Oak Park office?
questions.answer_span: Oak Park is closed every Monday.

questions.question: Which evening do you stay open late?
questions.answer_span: Wednesday: 8:00am to 7:00pm

questions.question: Can I come in on a Saturday?
questions.answer_span: Saturday: 9:00am to 2:00pm, first and third Saturday of each month only

questions.question: Are you closed over the Christmas holidays?
questions.answer_span: from December 24 through January 1 inclusive for the winter break

questions.question: Do I have to pay to park?
questions.answer_span: without validation the deck charges four dollars per hour

questions.question: How much does a routine cleaning cost?
questions.answer_span: Routine adult cleaning, also called a prophylaxis: $120

questions.question: What will my first visit cost if I want a cleaning too?
questions.answer_span: A first visit with both the exam and a cleaning is $305 in total.

questions.question: What does a root canal on a back tooth cost?
questions.answer_span: Root canal, molar: $1,380

questions.question: How much is a single dental implant all in?
questions.answer_span: Total for a single tooth implant, all three stages: $4,340

questions.question: Will my insurance pay for teeth whitening?
questions.answer_span: Whitening is considered cosmetic and is not covered by any dental insurance plan we work with.

questions.question: Do you take Humana?
questions.answer_span: We are not in network with Humana dental plans

questions.question: I have a Cigna DHMO plan, can I be seen?
questions.answer_span: we take Cigna DPPO but not Cigna DHMO

questions.question: Do you accept Medicaid?
questions.answer_span: We do not accept Medicaid, NC Health Choice, or any state dental assistance program at either office.

questions.question: Can I spread the cost of a big treatment plan over several months?
questions.answer_span: twenty five percent down, then the balance over six monthly installments with no interest and no credit check

questions.question: How long until I get a refund if I was overcharged?
questions.answer_span: Refunds for overpayment are issued within fourteen business days

questions.question: Do you charge me if I miss an appointment?
questions.answer_span: The second and any subsequent occurrence within the same twelve months is charged a fifty dollar fee.

questions.question: Can my twelve year old come to an appointment on their own?
questions.answer_span: Patients under fourteen must be accompanied by an adult at every visit, without exception.

questions.question: What happens if a filling you placed breaks?
questions.answer_span: Composite fillings placed by us are guaranteed for two years

questions.question: Is there a fee to send my records to a different dentist?
questions.answer_span: There is no charge for the first copy of a record sent to you or transferred to another dental office.

questions.question: How long do I have to wait before smoking after a tooth extraction?
questions.answer_span: do not smoke for at least seventy two hours

questions.question: Can I get a crown done in a single visit?
questions.answer_span: Same-day crowns are milled in the office from a ceramic block while you wait.

questions.question: Do you offer laughing gas and how much is it?
questions.answer_span: We offer nitrous oxide, sometimes called laughing gas, at both offices at ninety five dollars per visit.

questions.question: My child knocked out a tooth, how should I pick it up?
questions.answer_span: Pick the tooth up by the crown, the chewing surface, and never by the root.

questions.question: Does it cost extra to be seen in the middle of the night?
questions.answer_span: an after-hours surcharge of two hundred dollars applies on top of the treatment fee

questions.question: Can I put an aspirin on a painful tooth?
questions.answer_span: Do not place aspirin directly against the gum or the tooth.

questions.question: How soon can I get in as a new patient?
questions.answer_span: The wait for a new patient appointment is typically two to three weeks at Riverside and one to two weeks at Oak Park.

questions.question: Does anyone in the office speak Spanish?
questions.answer_span: Two of our front desk staff speak Spanish

questions.question: At what age should a baby first see a dentist?
questions.answer_span: a first dental visit by the first birthday, or within six months of the first tooth appearing

questions.question: How many hours a day do clear aligners need to be worn?
questions.answer_span: They need to be in the mouth twenty two hours a day

questions.question: Should I rinse with water after I brush?
questions.answer_span: Spit, do not rinse.

questions.question: Is it how much sugar I eat or how often that causes cavities?
questions.answer_span: Decay is driven by how often sugar is consumed, not by the total amount.

questions.question: What actually helps with bad breath?
questions.answer_span: A tongue scraper used once a day is more effective than mouthwash.

questions.question: Should I sleep wearing my dentures?
questions.answer_span: Take dentures out at night.

questions.question: How much is a custom mouthguard for playing sports?
questions.answer_span: A custom-made sports mouthguard is one hundred and eighty dollars

questions.question: I take warfarin, do I stop it before having a tooth out?
questions.answer_span: should not stop taking them before dental treatment unless the prescribing doctor has specifically told them to

questions.question: Is dental work safe while pregnant?
questions.answer_span: Dental treatment during pregnancy is safe and routine care should not be postponed.

questions.question: How much antibiotic do I take before my appointment?
questions.answer_span: The standard regimen is two grams of amoxicillin taken one hour before the appointment.

questions.question: Do you have anything for patients with no insurance?
questions.answer_span: The in-house membership plan is three hundred and forty nine dollars per year for an adult

questions.question: Is there a discount if I pay the whole thing upfront?
questions.answer_span: paid in full at the start receive a five percent courtesy discount

questions.question: Can I do an appointment over video instead of coming in?
questions.answer_span: We do short video consultations for triage
